value.rationale: A global sharp quantitative stability law for arbitrary radial Fock Hilbert weights is a meaningful structural strengthening of the qualitative Korenblum principle. The best factor is an exact relative variance of the radial measure, and thin-annulus degeneration describes a genuine robustness transition while sharp radius remains constant. It controls an intrinsic Schur-state distance, not an arbitrary artificial slice.
